day1_night_start.text: *I put water on for noodles and take the transfer papers from my bag.*

day1_night_home_2.text: *On the back of the transfer papers, I write down the names I heard today.*

day1_night_home_3.text: *The school gate I walked through this morning, the unfamiliar corridors, and my newly assigned window seat come back to me one after another. The scent of ramen starting to boil fills the room.*

day1_night_phone_2.text: *The group chat from my old school. Beneath the message I sent this morning—'I transferred. How's everyone doing?'—there is a single gray check.*

day1_night_phone_3.text: *No one has read it. Read by 0.*

day1_night_phone_4.text: *On my walk home, I sent one more line to Minsu after messaging him this morning: 'Hey, Minsu. I transferred. This school is pretty big.' Still no reply.*

day1_night_phone_5.text: *I opened the message input box, then closed it. I had nothing to send.*

day1_night_phone_6.text: *Just as I'm about to set the phone down, a messenger notification chimes. It's Sea, whose number I got earlier today.*

day1_night_sea_2.text: Oh, by the way—I'm packing plenty for lunch again tomorrow.

day1_night_sea_3.text: Any side dishes you really like? Taking requests for tomorrow's menu.

day1_night_sea_reply_2.text: Got it. Don't be surprised tomorrow.

day1_night_sleep_1.text: *I lie in bed and stare at the ceiling.*

day1_night_sleep_3.text: *As soon as I lay my head down, the pillow sinks deep beneath it. Crisp bedsheets brush the back of my neck.*

day1_night_sleep_4.text: *Between heavy eyelids, a stain on the dark ceiling flickers past: three short lines and a mark curving left.*

day1_night_sleep_5.text: *I blink once, and it turns back into an ordinary water stain. Leaving it at that, I close my eyes.*

day1_night_key_1.text: *Just as I'm drifting into a light sleep, a brief metallic sound rings from the front door. Click—just once.*

day1_night_key_2.text: *Was it a dream? I half-open my eyes. The room is dark, and the door is still closed.*

day1_night_key_3.text: *I checked the clock. 2:14 AM. The entryway sensor light turns on for the briefest moment, then goes out.*

day1_night_key_4.text: *I pull the covers closer and close my eyes again.*

day1_night_sleep_photo.text: *Between the pages of my closed notebook, the edge of the Polaroid Yuna handed me peeks out slightly.*

day1_night_sleep_tea.text: *From the pouch of tea bags beside the desk lamp drifts a gentle hint of chamomile.*

day1_night_sleep_milk.text: *Set upright on one side of my desk is the milk carton Sea gave me this morning.*

day1_night_app_1.text: In a corner of the home screen sat the provisional install icon I'd downloaded from the QR code on the enrollment leaflet. Beneath a blue shield, it read 'Student Safety App.'

day1_night_app_2.text: The leaflet noted that basic notices and the timetable could be viewed even before registering a student ID officially.

day1_night_app_3.text: I opened Settings while still unregistered. Three collapsed items appeared, with little check marks already beside them.

day1_night_app_4.text: The first item was real-time location. Beneath a note explaining it was for commute safety, the address of Haedoji School was listed.

day1_night_app_5.text: The second was microphone detection of sleep patterns. It was already checked before formal registration, so I tapped the description.

day1_night_app_6.text: The text about calculating the noise level within the device was long and went off the screen in the middle.

day1_night_app_7.text: Next to Heart Rate Sync, there was no device connected. It may be a function used during physical education class.

day1_night_app_8.text: I tried pushing the permission switch. The fingertips moved, but the gray circle remained in place.

day1_night_app_9.text: When the “Administrator Settings” sign appeared, I looked again at the life guidance section in the admissions notice.

day1_night_app_10.text: It said formal registration would be done tomorrow with my homeroom teacher. I could ask then.

day1_night_app_11.text: When I plugged in the charging cable, a speck of dust stuck to the terminal. I removed it with my fingernail and turned the screen back on.

day1_night_app_12.text: Below the notices section on the app's main screen, tomorrow's timetable for our class was posted.
choices: Take a screenshot of the timetable

day1_night_app_13.text: Back on the home screen, the blue shield icon sat right next to Minsu's still-unanswered chat.

day1_night_app_14.text: When I pulled down the notification shade, a pinned banner read that the safety app was running in the background. My finger paused over the gray toggle.

day1_night_app_choice.text: I might ask tomorrow. Still, I wanted to press it at least once.
choices: Re-open the chat room sent to Minsu
Reduce screen brightness and cover it

day1_night_app_kill_1.text: When I pressed the end button, the screen turned off once. Seeing that the charging indicator is alive, it doesn't mean the power has gone out.

day1_night_app_kill_2.text: Student Guidance & Safety Management active. As the small toast notice faded, the shield icon reappeared.

day1_night_app_kill_3.text: An underlined line on the leaflet said administrator access could be disabled after registering at the staff room. I'd skimmed past it earlier.

day1_night_app_kill_4.text: If I messed with it and disrupted tomorrow's student card registration, that would be a hassle. I should ask my homeroom teacher first tomorrow.

day1_night_app_kill_5.text: Not wanting to stir up unnecessary trouble on my very first day, I closed the settings menu and returned to the home screen.

day1_night_app_flash_aux.text: Entrusted education and life guidance standard protocol in operation

day1_night_app_minsu_1.text: Beneath the message and morning walk photo I'd sent Minsu, a single gray check mark still hung alone.

day1_night_app_minsu_2.text: I clicked on profile. Instead of a face taken at the playground, a gray circle appeared for a long time.

day1_night_app_minsu_3.text: The basic silhouette that appeared in place of the photo was the same even if you went back and pressed it again.

day1_night_app_minsu_4.text: Because it is a mountain valley, the base station seems to be weak. The Wi-Fi sign has also just been reduced by one space.

day1_night_app_minsu_5.text: I wrote and deleted the sentence urging a reply. It was time for Minsu to use his cell phone at the academy.

day1_night_app_minsu_6.text: I just added good night and closed the chat window after confirming that the send button was displayed.

day1_night_app_dim_1.text: When I turned down the brightness, my forehead was reflected on the screen. The head that was depressed in the morning remained floating in the same direction until night.

day1_night_app_dim_2.text: Better get ready a little earlier tomorrow morning. After checking the charging indicator, I clicked the phone back to the lock screen.

day1_night_app_dim_3.text: I decided to erase the notification number on the shield icon in the morning. There were five names that I wrote down today.

day1_night_riin_msg_1.text: It vibrated and I turned my phone over to see the name tag of the health center on the school app messenger.

day1_night_riin_msg_2.text: How did you like the chamomile I gave you earlier? Figured the scent might feel unfamiliar if it's your first time trying it.

day1_night_riin_msg_3.text: Beside the sink sat the mug where I'd just steeped one of the tea bags. Inside the empty cup, the scent of yellow petals lingered.

day1_night_riin_msg_4.text: You had a busy first day, learning names and finding classrooms. Have you had a chance to lie down?

day1_night_riin_msg_5.text: I wrote that I was sitting on the bed and did not send a photo of the crumpled blanket. I held the screen a little closer.

day1_night_riin_msg_6.text: If you have trouble sleeping, drop by again at lunch tomorrow. You can pick your drink this time.

day1_night_riin_msg_7.text: A little teacup emoji sat at the end of her message bubble. It made me think of her calm hands passing me that paper cup earlier today.

day1_night_riin_msg_8.text: I shut the window and gave my mug a quick rinse. Once I shook the water off my hands, the cursor in the reply box caught my eye again.

choices: Thanks to the tea, I got some rest. thank you
I say hello and put down my phone.

day1_night_riin_msg_thanks_1.text: Glad to hear it. Save the other tea bag for a night when sleep won't come. Good night.

day1_night_riin_msg_pick_1.text: All right. I'll still check anything strong, even if you pick it yourself.

day1_night_riin_msg_sleep_1.text: The screen went dark before the read receipt appeared. Only the light at the end of the charging cable remains.

day1_night_yuna_msg_1.text: A new contact appeared in the school messenger. A short message followed the name Choi Yuna from the photography club.

day1_night_yuna_msg_2.text: Senpai, please don't go near the old building late at night, just in case. Security makes rounds after dark.

day1_night_yuna_msg_3.text: Checking the time, it was already late enough to turn in. Since the darkroom in the old building had come up before we parted ways, she must have wanted to give me a heads-up.

day1_night_yuna_msg_4.text: And please don't lose the photo I gave you earlier! Don't just shove it straight into your pocket where it'll crease, either.

day1_night_yuna_msg_5.text: I cleared the loose papers off my desk and slipped the Polaroid between the pages of a notebook, nudging it in so the corners wouldn't stick out.

day1_night_yuna_msg_6.text: If you ask the other kids how to get to the old building, a lot of the time they'll give confusing directions. Ask me tomorrow during the day instead.

day1_night_yuna_msg_7.text: When I clicked on the small camera icon in the chat window, the introduction only listed the photography club activity times.

day1_night_yuna_msg_8.text: I was about to write a reply, but Yuna sent me a dot first and then deleted it. I also erased the first letter I wrote.

day1_night_yuna_msg_choice.text: I pressed the corner of the paper inserted into the notebook once more.
choices: I'll ask you tomorrow about the road.
Do you know when patrol ends?
Thanks for letting me know. good night

day1_night_yuna_msg_ask_1.text: Yes. Just head over to the library or the photography club room after lunch.

day1_night_yuna_msg_time_1.text: I'm not really sure about that either. It's late tonight, so please just get some sleep, Senpai. I'm turning my phone off now too.

day1_night_yuna_msg_bye_1.text: Instead of Yuna's reply, a small moon emoticon came. I closed the notebook and turned off the stand.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_1.text: Before I could put my phone down, the school app notification popped up one more time. This time it was the name of my homeroom teacher.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_2.text: How were your first-day classes? You must have done plenty of walking trying to find your classroom.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_3.text: I looked where I had left my sneakers off. There was still a trace of a folded sock on the heel.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_4.text: Even more cherry blossoms will be out tomorrow. Take a look to the left of the main gate on your way in.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_5.text: This morning everything by the gate felt unfamiliar, so I'd walked straight toward the building entrance—tomorrow I might have enough breathing room to look around.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_6.text: You can read the safety app notices tomorrow. No need to memorize everything on day one.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_7.text: When I deleted the reply while writing it, the typing indicator also turned off. There was no urging message from the teacher.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_8.text: Since I put my textbooks in the front compartment of my bag, I don't have to search my entire desk looking for books tomorrow.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_choice.text: I decided to say hello to the teacher and turn off my phone.
choices: Thanks to you, I was less lost. See you tomorrow
Can I ask about the safety app permissions tomorrow?
Yes, teacher, please rest well too.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_kind_1.text: That's a relief. Guess if we bump into each other in the hall tomorrow, you won't have to start by asking for directions. Good night, {name}.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_app_1.text: Of course—we'll look through the guide together tomorrow and I'll walk you through it. For now, just plug your phone in and get some rest.

day1_night_eunsu_msg_rest_1.text: A flower emoticon was added after the greeting. I set the alarm and turned over my phone.

day1_history_callback_1.text: My eyes drifted to the pouch of chamomile tea bags resting on my desk. Nurse Riin had mentioned it wasn't unusual to lose sleep on the first night.

day1_history_callback_2.text: I remembered the carton of chocolate milk standing at the corner of my desk. Thinking back to Sea handing it to me that morning eased the tension from my fingertips over the screen.

day1_history_callback_3.text: Yuna carrying her camera around earlier crossed my mind. She seemed like someone who'd know her way around the school app's features if I asked later.

day1_history_callback_4.text: Her reply offering to go over the guide together tomorrow put me at ease. There was no need to send the same question twice this late at night.

day1_expansion_action_1_a.text: Saving a screenshot of the timetable meant I could check my first class right away in the morning without reopening the app.

day1_expansion_action_1_b.text: Opening and closing the notice window knocked the badge count down by one. I tucked just the pens I'd need tomorrow into the front pocket of my bag.
